title: Countdown Day 38
excerpt: Remember, our goal is not debate and division yielding hate or a new state, but rather questioning that leads to conversation and friendship on the new quest. (23) From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
body:
Remember, our goal is not debate and division yielding hate or a new state, but rather questioning that leads to conversation and friendship on the new quest. (23)

 From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
